preferred_rewards.note: Owner's Bank of America Preferred Rewards tier on both cards. The boost multiplies every card rate on them (Unlimited Cash 1.5% -> 2.625%, Customized Cash 3% / 2% / 1% -> 5.25% / 3.5% / 1.75%), not BankAmeriDeals offer amounts. 75% through the until date (the owner's estimate), then 50%.

U.S. Bank.label: U.S. Bank offer
U.S. Bank.note: Deals are activated once and redeem on any eligible U.S. Bank card. The headline always uses Smartly; Cash+ is never recommended (owner uses it for one utility bill).

Capital One.label: Capital One offer
Capital One.note: Each offer is applied to one chosen card ("Apply my offer to"), and in-store offers lock to that card, so an offer is never ready on both. Shown under After activating as "add to <card>", whichever card earns more there.

Bank of America.label: BofA offer
Bank of America.note: Per-card behavior unconfirmed: the stored activation state is used, and the better of the two cards is picked (rates include the Preferred Rewards boost).
